notes.subject: jalaki seginna n ka kɔnɔ la
notes.rationale: prayer returned to my bosom: waajuri bɛ segin (KJV/ASV), walima a ma ja (JPS: 'may it return'), walima a jaabila tiɲɛ na (BSB 'unanswered')

notes.subject: kɔnɔ
notes.rationale: חיק ye kɔnɔ/fɛn min bɛ taamini bolo, a tɛ 'nyɛda' ye; a bɛnnen don 'kɔnɔ' (chest/lap) ma

notes.subject: salimabaga fɔli Yawe ma
notes.rationale: salmu in ye salimabagakɔrɔta ye, a bɛ Yawe wele nin mɔgɔ juguw lajɛli kɔnɔ

translation: Nka n ye: ni u tun bɛ banaya la, n ka donkili tun ye saka don ⟨ye⟩; n ye n ka ni nɔgɔya bɔ ni sonkali ye; n ka jalaki tun seginna n ka kɔnɔ la.

tokens.gloss: ni u tun bɛ banaya la
n ye n ka ni nɔgɔya bɔ
